searchText: I put up a PR to allow setting the max CPU/mem limits for spamoor, since on my machine the current values were limiting blobv1 transactions. let me know if there's a better way to do this 🙂 https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/1001 devnet-7 scope now that we shipped pectra, lets focus on peerdas! we need a `blobs` emoji Idk about blobs, but I think fusaka should definitely use a zebra emoji (though unfortunately it's not matching with the kenya interop anymore) because of the column sampling why not a tiger just kidding 🐡 i think this one is closest to blobfish tiger's stripes are randomly sized (more or less), fits well with validator custody <:crazycry:932693133546889216> we had the blowfish with 4844 https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1349696533922320478/1369768901478715412/IMG_2486.png?ex=681d1033&is=681bbeb3&hm=aca88f71ad0afcca69a2cad9afab1b52e325edcfc4d4dacda3a1a992bd07fc37& what a time to be alive This literally just appeared in my dreams
